mapper.sql: r.report_id, r.target_type, r.target_id, r.reporter_user_id, r.reporter_user_type, r.source_url, r.reason_code, r.reason_text, r.status, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at, r.review_note, r.delete_yn, r.created_by, r.created_ip, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_ip, r.updated_at, COALESCE(a.title, LEFT(c.content, 100), ct.title) AS target_title, u.login_id AS reporter_login_id

FROM tb_bbs_report r LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_article a ON r.target_type = 'ARTICLE' AND a.article_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN tb_bbs_comment c ON r.target_type = 'COMMENT' AND c.comment_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN tb_content ct ON r.target_type = 'CONTENT' AND ct.content_id = r.target_id LEFT JOIN v_user_login u ON u.user_id = r.reporter_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_report ( report_id, target_type, target_id, reporter_user_id, reporter_user_type, source_url, reason_code, reason_text, status, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reporterUserId}, #{reporterUserType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{reasonCode}, #{reasonText}, 'PENDING', 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_bbs_report r LEFT JOIN v_user_login u ON u.user_id = r.reporter_user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_report SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, review_note = #{reviewNote}, updated_by = #{reviewedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_bbs_report SET status = 'REVIEWED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, review_note = #{reviewNote}, updated_by = #{reviewedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_bbs_report WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
